claims.claim: PS4 Fat Double Pad Good Condition
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black PlayStation-style console and one matching controller, but no readable PS4/Fat model text and no condition/working indicators (power-on, disc read, Wi‑Fi, button tests) are shown.

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (PS4 Fat vs another PlayStation model) and/or wrong generation
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console label/model number (e.g., on the back/bottom) and the controller model/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown PlayStation console with unknown model and unknown specs.

risks.risk: Controller count mismatch (seller says double pad, but witness only saw one controller)
risks.proof: Photo showing both controllers together, including face/buttons and the full set of accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + one controller (not two).

risks.risk: Not actually in good working condition (may not power on, may not read discs, may not connect to Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth)
risks.proof: Short video clip: power on → home screen loads → disc read (or game boots) → Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth connection shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: for parts/repair or limited functionality).

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in the provided shots (scratches/cracks, damaged ports, loose disc drive)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports (USB/HDMI/Ethernet), disc drive area, and corners/edges; include a photo of any cracks/scratches with good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used with possible wear; do not assume no damage.

risks.risk: Controller issues (stick drift, unresponsive buttons, weak battery)
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller connected and a quick input test (analog movement without drift, button presses responding) plus battery/charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (assume possible drift/weak battery).

risks.risk: Storage/OS/account readiness (HDD/SSD size unknown; may be wiped incorrectly or account-locked)
risks.proof: Photo/video of system storage screen (capacity) and account/login status (show it boots to settings/home and storage info).
risks.if_unproven: Price as storage/account readiness unknown (assume buyer may need setup and/or replacement).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the console model/serial label (back or bottom) showing exact PS4 model (Fat/other) and region.
Photo showing both controllers together (to confirm 'double pad') and any included charging accessories.
Short power-on video: home screen loads successfully.
Video showing disc read or game boot (or at least successful game launch).
Close-up photos of ports and any cracks/scratches on console and controller.
Controller test video: analog stick movement without drift + button responsiveness + charging/battery status.
response.reason: The witness confirms a PlayStation-style console and one controller, but the key details needed to price safely (exact PS4 Fat model, whether there are two controllers, and whether it works) are not verifiable from the provided shots.
